name: Meta Blog - Modern Blogging Platform
summary: A responsive and elegant blog website allowing users to explore, read, and interact with articles in a modern interface.
description: Meta Blog is a personal blogging platform developed using React and TailwindCSS. It features a clean, minimal design for reading and exploring blog posts. It includes categories, author details, responsive layout, and modern animations.
keyFeatures: Responsive blog listing and article detail pages
challenges: Designing a responsive layout compatible with all devices
Structuring reusable and scalable component architecture
Optimizing images and assets for fast load times
futurePlans: Integrate a backend with database for post management

name: Panto Furniture - Furniture E‑commerce UI
summary: A stylish e‑commerce furniture website focusing on minimal design and smooth UI interactions.
description: Panto Furniture is a modern furniture store front‑end built with React and TailwindCSS. It showcases product cards, categories, and elegant hero sections, designed for smooth browsing and visual appeal.
keyFeatures: Hero section with featured product carousel
Clean typography and spacing using TailwindCSS
Simple cart button and navigation system
challenges: Maintaining consistent responsive design across sections
Optimizing image assets for better performance
Fine‑tuning animation performance on low-end devices
futurePlans: Add shopping cart and checkout functionality
Include user authentication and wishlist feature

name: Doctor Care - Healthcare Service Website
summary: A clean and modern healthcare service landing page providing users with essential medical information in a simple, responsive layout.
description: Doctor Care is a modern healthcare service landing page built with React and TailwindCSS. It features a responsive hero section, service cards, contact section, and clean UI optimized for a professional medical website.
keyFeatures: Fully responsive medical service landing page
Clean and modern UI with TailwindCSS
challenges: Maintaining visual consistency in a professional-themed UI
futurePlans: Create dynamic service management with backend
Add testimonial and doctor team sections
